items.source_en:
The crew members who consumed Gutierrez's body have all fallen ill. Call it divine retribution, or just rotten luck, but none of them were able to hold the meal down. Now we're down to half a crew trying to get this engine functional. 

On top of that, the leaks are getting worse, but it seems at this point we've decided to just put all our eggs into repairing the engines and deal with the gas after. 

Blessed father, I'm still haunted by that pirate attack. I keep replaying the moment when they hailed us. If only I ran the scan first, and jumped to safety. If only I had been more skeptical, none of this would have come to pass. I know this is merely a test, and part of his plan. But why do I feel like I have failed him?
